subject: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart

Hi all,

Following Evelyn's midyear calibration and the performance write-up, I'm requesting an exception approval to recalibrate her total comp. Summary: she received an exceptional rating during the June performance cycle (consistently over-target on Q1-Q2 OKRs, customer escalations resolved, and mentoring two new hires). Market comp analysis shows she's ~18% below target for her role and level in our region.

Proposal (manager recommendation):
- Base salary increase from $165,000 to $179,000 (approx +8.5% immediate raise).
- One-time discretionary cash bonus: $12,000 to make up near-term pay gap while equity refresh is queued.
- Short equity refresh in the next cycle (requesting exception to grant 0.018 RSUs as an accelerated refresh).

Rationale: rapid retention risk; candidate interest from competitors; delivering high impact on two enterprise accounts. I've attached the comp proposal spreadsheet and a one-page manager justification that includes market comps and calibration notes.

Requested approvals: Laura and Markus for leadership approval; Neha for HR path and legal/comp process. If we can approve this this week, we'll route the compensation paperwork to payroll/finance for an effective date of 2026-06-15.

Attachments: comp_proposal_evelyn_20260606.xlsx (proposed numbers), manager_justification_evelyn.pdf (qualitative summary).

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Applied ML Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart

Thanks Marcus — got the materials and read through the justification. A few quick asks before I sign off:

1) Can you confirm budget owner for the recurring base increase? Which pool will this pull from (team budget vs central comp reserve)?
2) Are you considering promotion (level change) or purely a market-regrade? If promotion, we need a promotion packet.
3) If we can't move full delta into base for headcount/budget reasons, authorize me to evaluate a hybrid (smaller base + larger one-time).

If you can answer 1–2, I can give an initial nod and loop in finance for the one-time bonus approval.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart

Appreciate the packet, Marcus. From an HR/process perspective:
- We can approve an out-of-cycle base increase up to the band ceiling with a leadership sign-off and updated offer letter. Anything above the band ceiling requires a comp-committee exception (takes 3–5 business days).
- One-time discretionary bonuses under $15k are routable through People Ops with Financial acknowledgement; payroll will process once finance provides a charge code.
- Equity refresh exceptions require an executive-level exception and disclosure for our audit trail.

Please confirm the preferred path — if you want to maximize immediate retention, approve the proposed mix (8.5% base + $12k bonus) and I will: 1) reserve the comp delta from your team's headcount pool, 2) submit the bonus routing to payroll, and 3) draft the necessary comp-committee request for the equity refresh.

Attachments: (none)

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. People Operations Partner
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart

Thanks for pulling this together. Marcus — I support the retention-first approach but would prefer a modest tradeoff to preserve budget headroom: approve an 8% base increase effective 6/15 and the $12k one-time bonus now. Defer the equity refresh to the next cycle unless the comp-committee rules otherwise.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm you accept the 8% + $12k approach so Neha can reserve funds and loop finance.
- Laura: if that aligns with People strategy, give final sign-off on the one-time bonus routing.
- Neha: please prepare the comp request for the committee for the equity ask (I don't want to block the immediate cash-based retention).

I copied Rishi so execs are aware; if we need an exception for equity immediacy, we'll escalate.

-Markus
VP, Product Operations
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Special compensation recalibration & one-off bonus approval for Evelyn Hart

Sounds good — I accept the 8% base increase + $12k one-time bonus approach. Marcus (me) will proceed with the updated numbers and sign the revised offer letter. Neha, please reserve the headcount comp delta from my team budget and route the bonus to payroll with the attached charge code once finance confirms.

Evelyn — thank you for your work, and we'll follow up with formal paperwork and an updated offer letter by EOD Monday.

Next steps:
- Neha to reserve funds and submit payroll routing (target: 6/15 effective).
- Laura to finalize People Ops sign-off for bonus routing.
- Markus to kick off comp-committee request if equity needs acceleration.

Thanks all.
Marcus
Director, Applied ML Platform
